protocol: Derived source-passage retrieval. One known source passage per question, 488 candidates and 900 questions per language. No multiple-choice answers used. No tuning. No claim of complete semantic relevance judgments.

bm25.tokens: NFC, language-aware lowercase for Turkish/Azerbaijani, Unicode alphanumeric runs excluding underscore
bm25.grid_scope: exploratory test-set sensitivity; no best k selected

tie_policy: Expected metric under uniformly random ordering of all gold-score ties, atol=1e-6; no row-order tie breaking

minilm.pooling: attention-mask mean over all retained tokens including specials, then L2 normalization

xlmr.pooling: attention-mask mean over all retained tokens including specials, then L2 normalization
